shortDescription: CLAT 2027 UG and PG Syllabus – sections, topics and exam pattern overview.
content:
CLAT 2027 syllabus is prescribed by the Consortium of NLUs for undergraduate and postgraduate law admissions.

CLAT UG sections (typical)

  • English Language
  • Current Affairs including General Knowledge
  • Legal Reasoning
  • Logical Reasoning
  • Quantitative Techniques

CLAT PG

  • Constitutional Law
  • Other areas of law (Jurisprudence, Contract, Torts, Criminal Law, International Law, IPR etc. as notified)

Confirm latest pattern on consortiumofnlus.ac.in.
